messages:
Maria: FYI I've dropped a PRD draft for the API contract covering chat/completions, embeddings, and rerank. Need acceptance criteria, example payloads, and a short list of unresolved risks by EOD. Link: https://redwood.docs/prd/api-contract-v1
Ajay: grabbing it now
doc-bot: Document created: /prd/api-contract-v1 (owner: Maria)
Lina: quick first pass — a couple items:
• Rerank: define tie-breaker/deterministic ordering when scores equal
• Scoring scale: we should normalize on 0..1 or explicit negatives? callers assume 0..1
Sam: embeddings: we need behavior for vector dim mismatch. current note says 'reject' but no error shape specified
Theo: chat/completions edge-case: if streaming response is cut (client disconnect) while a function call is requested by model, what's the canonical semantics? do we still run function? cancel?
Maria: good. Proposals:
• tie-breaker: stable sort by (score desc, doc_id asc, ingestion_ts desc) — short and deterministic
• scoring: require normalized 0..1; if source is -1..1 map and warn in audit logs
• function-calls during streaming: server must attempt function execution if model emitted the call before final token; if execution fails due to client disconnect, return async webhook event to customer's callback endpoint (configurable)
Ajay: for embeddings: acceptance criteria suggestion:
1) request with expected "dimension" header mismatch -> 400 with body {"error":"dimension_mismatch","expected":<n>,"got":<m>} 
2) if model returns variable dim (rare) -> reject and log a model-onboarding alert
Lina: Enterprise ask: per-request model pinning + canary by route. PRD has rollout policy section but not explicit per-request override. Customer legal requires audit trail for model selection.
Maria: add per-request model override header X-Redwood-Model, and wire audit events (model_id, reason, user_id) to the event stream. For Dedicated/Private call out that KMS must be enabled to log model selection if required by compliance docs.
Sam: also need to specify rate-limit semantics/extensions: X-Quota-Remaining, X-Quota-Reset, X-Model-Variant in headers. Acceptance test should validate header presence and semantics under burst.
Theo: rerank edge-case: when sources have identical content/ids, stable sort by doc_id won't help. Suggest tie-breaker fallback to internal similarity fingerprint then ingestion_ts. We'll note as low-likelihood but include tests.
Lina: I'll paste minimal example payloads for the PRD — please review and call out missing fields:
```
# Embeddings request
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "rw-embed-1",
  "input": ["doc a", "doc b"],
  "expected_dimensions": 1536
}
# Embeddings error response (dim mismatch)
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{ "error": "dimension_mismatch", "expected": 1536, "got": 768 }

# Rerank response (stable ranks)
{
  "query_id": "q-123",
  "results": [
    {"doc_id":"d1","score":0.92},
    {"doc_id":"d2","score":0.92, "tie_breaker":"ingestion_ts:2024-06-12T12:00:00Z"}
  ]
}
```
Ajay: thumbs up for payload shapes. I'll add specific smoke tests to QA board: streaming+function-call, embedding-dim-mismatch, rerank-identical-scores, model-override audit trail.
Eva: I can own the smoke test matrix — will create test cases in TestRail and add automation stubs. ETA 2 working days for automation + 1 day for infra hooks.
Maria: timeline looks good. Targeting PRD merge by Fri EOD. If anyone has blocking items (legal, infra, security), flag them by tomorrow 11am PT.
Theo: infra note: for the async webhook fallback we need a retry policy defined and will need routing policy config in Dedicated. I'll write a short infra appendix.
Lina: small UX note: examples should show both streaming + final payloads for function-calls (customers keep getting confused). I'll add a small appendix with sequence diagrams.
Ajay: quick question on metrics: do we want per-model latency percentiles in the PRD? Product asked for p50/p90/p99 in the console.
Maria: yes include required metrics and retention: p50/p90/p99 latency, token-per-request distribution, error-rate by code. retention 90 days for Console, 365 for Enterprise export.
doc-bot: Document updated: /prd/api-contract-v1 (version: 1.2)
Eva: noted, starting on test cases now
Maria: thanks team. I'll fold these into the PRD and ping again when ready for final review. If anything else pops up, post here. :sparkles:
